_help: Edit this list to change the events shown in the app. See AGENTS.md for the rules. Use 'date' for the start (YYYY-MM-DD) and 'end' for the last day of a week- or month-long event; events hide themselves after they finish. 'host' is who runs it.

items.title: Walk For Awareness 2026
items.place: Captain Burke Park, Kangaroo Point, Brisbane, or Walk Anywhere
items.blurb: The flagship walk: 5km or 9km under the Story Bridge. Family, wheelchair and pet friendly. Kids 14 and under walk free.

items.title: Annual Fundraising Luncheon
items.blurb: An annual fundraising lunch with guest speakers, auctions and raffles, supporting mental health in South East Queensland.

items.title: Spot–Speak–Support workshops
items.blurb: A 45-minute mental health workshop for teams, led by professionals with lived experience.

items.title: Mental Health Month
items.blurb: This year's theme is Together we Thrive: small, everyday moments of care, kindness and conversation.

items.title: Queensland Mental Health Week
items.blurb: Free local events celebrating wellbeing. This year's theme is Build Community, Build Wellbeing.

items.title: World Mental Health Day
items.blurb: A day to start a conversation, check in on someone and look after your own mental health.

items.title: Movember
items.blurb: Grow a mo, move, or host an event to raise funds for men's health, including mental health and suicide prevention.

items.title: International Survivors of Suicide Loss Day
items.place: Local gatherings and free online events
items.blurb: A day for people who have lost someone to suicide to come together, share stories and find support.

items.title: Perinatal Mental Health Week
items.blurb: For anyone expecting, a new parent, trying to conceive, or grieving a pregnancy or infant loss, and the people around them.

items.title: R U OK? Day
items.blurb: A reminder to ask the people in your world how they're really going, and to keep asking all year.
